text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Streaming gateway error spike detected - elevated 5xx and connection resets in us-east-1 (since 10:06 UTC). Notifying oncall.

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Initial check: alerts show 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% -> 6.7% at 10:05. Any customer reports?

liv-cs: Got one incoming ticket, customer says chat sessions drop around token 300-400, they see 'stream closed' in client logs.

maria: Paging logs (edge NLB) show downstream RSTs and 502 from gateway. Looking at proxy->gateway latency also increased.

devin: Assigning to runtime - @ryan-eng-runtime can you triage gateway pods? Suspect chunked encoding handling regression from last deploy.

ryan-eng-runtime: Will check pod logs and recent deploys. Which cluster/region?

maria: us-east-1 prod, gateway pool gw-prod-7.

kevin: I see a deploy at 09:55 for gateway image v3.4.2. Rolling update completed by 10:00.

oncall-sre: If it's deploy-related we should attempt a rollback canary and route traffic to older revision. Can we scale gw-prod-6 (older ASG) up?

devin: Before rollback, let's gather logs. Ryan, can you paste a tail of gateway stderr where 5xx spike started? If possible include HTTP access lines and internal error traces.

ryan-eng-runtime: Pasting excerpt:
```
10:05:12 WARN connection handler - downstream reset by peer, client_id=abc123
10:05:13 ERROR http dispatch - upstream 502 from runtime-fanout-2: code=502, conn=reset
10:05:14 ERROR chunked decoder - unexpected EOF while parsing chunk-size
10:05:15 ERROR http handler - panic in response writer: write on closed connection
```

maria: That 'unexpected EOF while parsing chunk-size' looks bad. Could be a change in chunked parser from v3.4.2.

kevin: I scanned PRs in that release - there was a change touching chunked decoding to handle CRLF edgecases. Might have introduced a regression for broken client disconnects.

liv-cs: Customer reports also include high latency before disconnects. They send audio->transcript streaming; sessions time out around 30-40s.

oncall-sre: Ok, mitigation plan: (1) hotfix rollback traffic to v3.4.1 for gateways, (2) add gateway-level 502 smoothing/fallback to dedicated pool, (3) temporary increase keepalive timeouts on load balancer. Which is feasible fastest?

devin: Rolling back the gateway can be done via autoscaling group snapshot — I can trigger routing shift to ASG with v3.4.1 in 2-3 minutes.

ryan-eng-runtime: I can add a short circuit to treat chunked parse errors as client-cancel (no upstream 5xx) to reduce error noise, but that requires a tiny build and restart. Might be 8-12 minutes.

oncall-sre: Start rollback first. Devin, proceed. Ryan, start the patch in parallel. Maria, increase LB idle timeout to 120s and enable proxy_buffering off for gw-prod-7.

devin: Initiating rollback to v3.4.1 now. Routing change in progress.

maria: LB idle timeout changed. Proxy buffering off toggled.

ryan-eng-runtime: Building quick patch branch 'chunked-tolerate-eof'. Will push image; ETA ~10m.

incident-bot: :information_source: Deployment event: rollback initiated by devops-deploy at 10:12 UTC. Tracking task id deploy-7634.

oncall-sre: Monitoring metrics now. Anyone seeing improvement in 5xx rates?

maria: 10:16 - 5xx rate dropped to 3.1% (was 6.7). Connection resets down ~40%.

liv-cs: Customer confirmation: one customer reported sessions stabilized for a few minutes, then a single disconnect; overall better.

kevin: No longer seeing 'unexpected EOF while parsing chunk-size' in the new gateway logs after rollback.

ryan-eng-runtime: Pushed patch to a canary group, starting rollout to one pod to validate behavior.

devin: Rollback completed for 80% of gw-prod-7. Remaining pods draining.

oncall-sre: Good. Keep canary patch running. If patch reduces errors further we can promote. For now keep LB timeout change and rollback.

maria: Observability note: record the time windows, attach logs and correlation ids for affected clients. I'll open an incident ticket with timeline and affected customers.

liv-cs: I'll follow up with the ticketed customer and offer a postmortem once root cause confirmed. Noting customer impact: partial session loss for 12 customers, degraded latency for ~120 sessions.

oncall-sre: Action items: (1) Ryan complete PR and validation; (2) Kevin to run bisect between v3.4.1 and v3.4.2 to isolate faulty PR; (3) Maria to create incident doc with timeline; (4) Devin to coordinate rollback CSAT messaging. We'll reconvene in #incidents-ops in 30m. Thanks all.

maria: Incident doc created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026

ryan-eng-runtime: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/runtime/pull/412 - includes tolerant chunked parser and tests for truncated chunk-size.

kevin: Bisection scheduled and running - found candidate commit 9a7b3d touches parser state machine.

oncall-sre: Closing live mitigation. If rates remain low, we'll transition to followup and RCA. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated - 5xx rate trending down. Auto-update will post in 15m.
